name: SoapNoteVisit
title: SOAP Note Visit
description: HiiveHealth-style SOAP note visit template with checklist tasks for Subjective, Objective, Assessment, and Plan sections.

action.title: Document subjective section
action.description: Capture chief complaint, history of present illness, and review of systems.

action.title: Document objective section
action.description: Capture vital signs, physical exam findings, and objective observations.

action.title: Document assessment section
action.description: Capture assessment, diagnoses, and clinical impression.

action.title: Document plan section
action.description: Capture treatment plan, orders, disposition, and follow-up instructions.
